 November 3 Election and Early Voting
 October 19, 2026 
 Richardson ISD supports a culture of voting that encourages participation in the voting process. 
 During early voting and on Election Day, Tuesday, November 3, 2026, many Richardson ISD campuses will serve as official polling locations. Election Day is a student holiday and staff professional development day. 
 RISD Early Voting Location – October 19 – 30, 2026
 Arzell Ball Center Room 119D 410 S Greenville Ave, Richardson, TX 75081 
 Dallas County Early Voting Times
 Dates Day of the Week Hours 
 October 19 – October 23 Monday – Friday 7 AM – 7 PM 
 October 24 Saturday 7 AM – 7 PM 
 October 25 Sunday 12 PM – 6 PM 
 October 26 – October 30 Monday – Friday 7 AM – 7 PM 
 The November 2026 ballot will include many key races, including those for:
 State Senate and House of Representatives
 Texas Governor and Other Statewide Offices
 State Legislature and Board of Education
 Judicial and County Offices
 Local Propositions (where applicable)
 Additional voting resources can be found on the district website or the Dallas County Elections Department for important dates, a complete vote center map for early voting , your sample ballot and more. #RISDVotes
